name: Stalsinek IV
description: Stalsinek IV was an Inner Rim jungle planet located in the Hapes Cluster. It was the site of the Temple of Stalsinek, which in turn contained a fountain that was the source of legendary healing waters. During the Galactic Civil War, two groups of offworlders visited Stalsinek IV in order to acquire a sample of the healing waters, with one of the groups coming into contact with a local tribe of beings that worshiped at the temple.
